session.starting: The server is waking up, this can take about a minute.
session.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

errors.network: No connection. Try again once you are online.
errors.server: The server is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.

login.title: Sign in
login.wrongBody: Check your details and try again.
login.offlineBody: Turn on Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.
login.wakingBody: The server sleeps when it has not been used for a while. The first sign-in can take 30–60 seconds; keep the app open.
login.noAccount: No account? Ask your company's administrator.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.emptyBody: Take a photo below to add a new document from the field.
tasks.errorBody: The server did not answer. Try again a little later.
tasks.viewerNote: You are a viewer; you cannot upload documents.

pick.publishedNote: No documents can be added to a published batch.
pick.stepQuestion: Which step is the document for?

camera.align: Fit the document into the frame
camera.askBody: KozaPass needs your camera to photograph documents. The images are only used in the document you upload.
camera.deniedBody: Allow it in Settings to photograph documents.
camera.deniedStep3: Turn it on and come back

review.title: Review
review.moveHint: To change the order, press and hold a page, then tap the page to swap it with.
review.limitTitle: You reached the limit of {{max}} pages.
review.limitBody: Upload further pages as a separate document.
review.tooLargeBody: Take fewer pages or upload them as a separate document.
review.pickTarget: Tap the page to swap with
review.offline: No connection. The document is saved and goes up when the connection is back.

upload.readingSub: The fields are being taken from the document. This usually takes 10 s.
upload.waitSub: Starts once the upload is done.
upload.slowBody: You can keep waiting or fill in the fields yourself. The result is added to the form once the reading is done.
upload.failedBody: {{count}} pages are kept on the phone. Try again once you are connected.
upload.published: No documents can be added to a published batch.
upload.limit: A step can hold at most 10 documents.
upload.duplicate: This document is already uploaded for this step.
upload.tooLarge: The pages together are larger than 10 MB.
upload.badPage: Page {{n}} could not be read; take it again.
upload.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
upload.failedBodyQueue: Try again now or queue it; it goes up by itself when the connection is back.

form.title: Document
form.manualTitle: The document could not be read, enter the fields by hand.
form.manualBody: The image is blurred or the document type was not recognised.
form.requiredValidUntil: The end of validity is required
form.dateOrder: The end cannot be before the start
form.editorNote: The document is saved. It is used once an owner or admin approves it.
form.viewerNote: You are a viewer; you cannot change the fields.
form.conflictBody: Someone else approved this document. Your changes were not saved.
form.loadError: The document could not be loaded
form.readingNow: The document is still being read; the fields fill in once it is done.
form.saveFailed: The approval could not be saved.

profile.title: Profile
profile.logoutBody: Your e-mail and password are asked at the next sign-in. Pages not uploaded are deleted from the phone.

push.label: Notifications
push.expoGo: Notifications work only in the installed app. You are in Expo Go now.

profile.logoutPending: {{count}} documents are not uploaded yet; signing out deletes them from the phone.

scan.title: Scan QR
scan.hint: Scan the QR code on the product label or the passport
scan.askBody: We need the camera to scan QR codes. Nothing is recorded; only the code is read.
scan.deniedBody: We need the camera to scan QR codes. Allow it in Settings.
scan.deniedStep3: Turn it on and come back to the app
scan.unknownTitle: This code is not a KozaPass passport
scan.unknownBody: Scan the KozaPass QR code on the product label.
scan.offlineTitle: Could not look up the batch
scan.foreignTitle: This batch is not in your company
scan.foreignBody: We are opening the public passport in the in-app browser.

batch.title: Batch summary
batch.shoot: Photograph a document for this batch
batch.webNote: Use the web panel to edit the chain.
batch.publishedNote: Documents cannot be added to a published batch. Use the web panel to edit the chain.
batch.loadErrorBody: The server did not answer. Check your connection and try again.

step.lockedNote: Approving and asking for corrections needs the owner or admin role.
step.loadErrorBody: The submitted data could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.
step.conflictBody: Someone else reviewed it meanwhile. Your decision was not saved.

approved.title: Data approved
approved.allDone: Every step is approved; the batch is ready to publish.
approved.remaining: Remaining: {{steps}}. Once every step is approved the batch is ready to publish.

rejectSheet.title: Ask for a correction
rejectSheet.placeholder: Tell the supplier what to correct
rejectSheet.hint: The reason goes to the supplier and into the batch history.

sent.title: Correction requested.
sent.sub: Send the supplier a new link.
sent.failedBody: The correction request is saved; create the link again and send it.
sent.message: Hello, {{company}} asks you to correct your {{step}} data for batch {{batchNo}} ({{product}}): {{reason}} You can update the form until {{deadline}} through this link: {{url}} Thank you, {{name}}

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.askTitle: We'll let you know when new data arrives
notifications.askBody: Your phone gets a notification when a supplier sends data or a certificate is about to expire.
notifications.exampleBody: Ege İplik sent their data · KP-2026-0915-A
notifications.laterNote: You can turn them on later in Profile › Notifications.
notifications.deniedBody: Allow notifications in Settings. That is the only way new data and certificate alerts reach you.
notifications.failed: Notifications could not be turned on. Check your connection and try again.

queue.title: Upload queue
queue.stripWaitingOffline: {{count}} documents waiting to upload · no connection
queue.offline: No connection · they go up when it is back
queue.deleteBody: {{type}} · {{count}} pages are deleted from the phone and not uploaded. This cannot be undone.
queue.emptyBody: Documents photographed offline wait here and go up when the connection is back.

queued.title: Document queued
queued.sub: It goes up when the connection is back. You can close the app.
